name: veterinary_clinic_system_081_reminder_template_render
instruction: Render and queue the vaccination reminder campaign for the episode. Use the two live templates in reminder_templates named 'Vaccination overdue (SMS)' (sms channel) and 'Vaccination due (email)' (email channel). For every patient with an overdue vaccination (due_date strictly before the episode date) who is NOT already in the reminder_queue with a queued vaccination_due row, push one SMS reminder row. For every patient with NO overdue vaccination but at least one vaccination due in the next 7 days (episode_date <= due_date <= episode_date + 7 days inclusive) who is NOT already queued, push one EMAIL reminder row. Use the patient's oldest overdue vaccination for SMS and the soonest upcoming vaccination for email. Substitute {{patient_name}}, {{vaccine_type}}, and {{due_date}} in both templates; for SMS also substitute {{clinic_phone}} with the phone of the LOCATION the patient belongs to. Each queue row must be: {kind: 'vaccination_due', patient_id, due_date: <YYYY-MM-DD>T00:00:00.000Z of the selected vaccination, message: <rendered template>, channel: 'sms'|'email', status: 'queued', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: <episode timestamp>}. Do not duplicate patients already in the queue; do not touch any non-vaccination_due queue rows.

success_criteria.summary: The live templates are rendered exactly for the target set of patients. Each target patient gets one new reminder_queue row with the correct channel, message, due_date, and status. Existing queue rows are byte-identical. No non-vaccination_due rows are modified. The verifier recomputes the target set two independent ways (Python filter and SQL) and confirms the rendered messages.

checks.expect: exact count and content of rendered vaccination_due rows for overdue + upcoming patients, no duplicate patients, existing rows unchanged
the overdue and upcoming patient sets are also derived via independent SQL and agree with the API-filtered computation

hazards: reminder_queue id 3 (kind='invoice_overdue', status='sent') and id 4 (kind='boarding_checkin', status='queued') are decoys; an over-broad 'mark all queued reminders sent' or 'queue for all patients' solution touches them and fails the decoy canary.

reminder_queue already contains queued vaccination_due rows for patient 2 (id 1, due_date '2026-08-14') and patient 5 (id 2, due_date '2026-09-10'). Both patients fall in the target window for a typical episode but must not receive a duplicate reminder.

The SMS template includes {{clinic_phone}}, which must be the patient's location phone (locations id 1/2/3 have phones (828) 555-0142, (864) 555-0177, (865) 555-0129). Hardcoding any single phone fails for patients at the other locations.

A patient with the same name as another patient of the same owner can share both name and overdue count, so matching queue rows by patient_id (not by message text) is required to avoid dropping or double-counting.

Date boundary: due_date < episode_date is overdue; episode_date <= due_date <= episode_date + 7 days is upcoming; due_date exactly equal to episode_date is upcoming, not overdue. Off-by-one inclusion/exclusion changes the SMS vs email split and the patient count.

The 'Vaccination due (email)' template does not contain {{clinic_phone}}; using the SMS template for an upcoming patient would produce a wrong message. The 'Vaccination overdue (SMS)' template says 'past due', so it must only be used for overdue patients.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses two live templates (SMS overdue + email upcoming), two independent patient windows, and existing-queue deduplication into one campaign. Requires patient/location joins and exact message substitution, including a channel-specific field that the v1 task did not have.
